print: Where each refrain hymn of hymnal.db sings its refrain, read off its page on 2026-10-18: the engraving github.com/adventHymnals/SDAHImages, docs/seventh-day-adventist-hymnal/SDAHimages/NNN.png, unless `from` names another source. hymnal.db cannot say it: its refrain ids (-1, -2) do not tell the orders apart. Every hymn whose row has a refrain is listed, and only those: the compiler refuses a refrain with no entry, and an entry for a hymn with no refrain. A hymn whose printed fix writes each stanza with its own refrain (data/fixes/<n>.json) has no refrain in its row and is not listed.
